items.raw_excerpt: The building of the former Grémio da Lavoura, which was owned by the Coimbra Agricultural Cooperative, next to the deactivated Estação Nova train station, was sold for €5.8 million to a Spanish real estate fund.
items.summary_en: The old Grémio da Lavoura building in Coimbra was sold for 5.8 million euros. It belonged to the Coimbra Agricultural Cooperative and sits next to the closed Estação Nova train station. A Spanish real estate fund bought it, and it may become a housing project.
items.summary_ko: 코임브라의 옛 그레미우 다 라부라 건물이 580만 유로에 매각됐다. 이 건물은 코임브라 농업협동조합 소유였으며, 문을 닫은 이스타상 노바 기차역 옆에 있다. 스페인 부동산 펀드가 사들였고, 주택 사업으로 바뀔 수 있다.
items.title_en: Old cooperative building in Portugal may become housing
items.title_ko: 포르투갈 옛 협동조합 건물, 주택으로 바뀔 수도
items.title_original: Former Cooperative in Portugal may become housing project

items.raw_excerpt: Nicolás Carvacho anunció su adiós del baloncesto a los 29 años
items.summary_en: Chilean basketball player Nicolas Carvacho has announced his retirement at age 29. He is leaving the sport because of injuries. He played for the Chilean national team.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 농구 국가대표 니콜라스 카르바초가 부상 때문에 스물아홉 살에 은퇴를 발표했다. 그는 어린 나이에 선수 생활을 마치게 된 이유를 밝혔다.
items.title_en: Chilean basketball player Nicolas Carvacho retires at 29 due to injuries
